title_en: Apartment for sale near the botanical garden
description_en: I am selling an apartment of 108m2 gross, of which 97m2 are net. It is located on the 3rd floor of a 5-story building with elevators, completed in 2018. Fully approved by ASHK with all relevant documents, ownership certificate (TAPI). The apartment is for sale, invested and furnished in a contemporary style. The apartment has orientation and views from the east, south and west. Facilities: Bars, restaurants, pharmacy, gym, bus station and direct access to the big ring road of the city with exits from both sides, east and south. Area: Botanic Garden St.: Old Selita Postal code / 1001 Tirana Unit /13 Distance from the city center 3 km Lake residence. V 450m Rruga e Kosovarve 800 m The apartment is located in one of the quietest areas without being separated from the city at the same time. The building complex has maximum security, being monitored 24/7 with cameras. Appendix; The client has the opportunity to discuss and negotiate for the purchase of a parking space with an extra value of 30k euros. Selling price 257,000.
